info.text:
In 2010, a $40 stock sold for one penny.

In the May 6, 2010 flash crash, Accenture traded as low as $0.01 before closing at $41.09.
A market order fills now at the best available price, which isn't guaranteed. A limit order fills only at your price or better, but might not fill.
Over 20,000 trades 60%+ off their 2:40 p.m. prices were canceled.

Sources: SEC investor bulletin on order types, SEC-CFTC report (Sept 2010).
News and education, not financial advice.
